curriculum.name: count_open_calls_with
curriculum.goal: Given a person, return how many of the calls with that person are still open.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE count_open_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person} STATUS=OPEN
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
